mechanism.claim: When the cross section of liquid-alt aggressive flow develops an unusually strong one-sided tail while overall flow intensity is elevated, speculative risk transfer is arriving outside BTC first. Follow that alt-flow tail in BTC for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the median-centered cubic alt-order-flow tail mass
mechanism.why_distinct: Cross-alt flow leadership counts a sign majority and requires opposing BTC flow; flow centrality estimates dynamic leaders; flow geometry uses dispersion or diffusion. HVCAOFTAR uses the signed cubic tail asymmetry of six normalized alt flows and their cross-sectional RMS intensity, with no BTC flow or price, return, funding, OI, fitted outcome, prior event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: Both one-sided flow-tail asymmetry and cross-alt aggressive-flow intensity must enter causal upper tails; causal BTC RV20 q90 remains a post-stage audit.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: data-driven hourly cross-alt flow-tail onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_window: 60 exact bars_binance one-minute rows per symbol in [D-1h,D)
features.normalized_alt_flow: sum(2*taker_buy_quote-quote_asset_volume)/sum(quote_asset_volume) independently per symbol; denominator strict positive and result finite
features.cross_section_center: median of the six normalized alt flows
features.centered_flow: normalized alt flow minus the cross-sectional median
features.absolute_tail_mass: sum(abs(centered_flow) cubed), finite and strict positive
features.flow_asymmetry_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(flow_tail_asymmetry) over at most 720 earlier valid hours, minimum 672, current excluded; rank>=0.90
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: research-supported cross-market order-flow propagation translated into a source-available, outcome-blind cross-sectional tail-leadership state

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no symbol basket, flow formula, center, tail power, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
